leadText: Takahiro Yamashita (Japanese: やましたたかひろ or 山下たかひろ Yamashita Takahiro, born November 22, 1969 in Kyoto) is the creator of several Pokémon manga and the Pokémon Trading Card Game, having illustrated cards. Yamashita has worked on authoring and illustrating many video games into manga adaptations which were published in the CoroCoro magazines, these franchises including , , and . Additionally, Yamashita has published manga for the magazine where his manga adaptation appeared in.

Takahiro Yamashita (Japanese: やましたたかひろ or 山下たかひろ Yamashita Takahiro, born November 22, 1969 in Kyoto) is the creator of several Pokémon manga and the Pokémon Trading Card Game, having illustrated cards. Yamashita has worked on authoring and illustrating many video games into manga adaptations which were published in the CoroCoro magazines, these franchises including , , and . Additionally, Yamashita has published manga for the magazine where his manga adaptation appeared in.
